reddit.notes: Prefer real post-insight views when available. upvote_to_view_multiplier assumes a ~1% upvote-to-view ratio (midpoint of the typical 0.5-2% range). comment_to_view_multiplier is a low-confidence fallback of last resort for very early posts with no upvotes yet, based on a rough analogy to general web-forum reply-to-view ratios (~10-25 views per reply), not Reddit-specific evidence.

x.notes: engagement = likes + retweets + replies + bookmarks. Multiplier corresponds to a ~0.5% engagement rate, deliberately set between the 2026 platform-wide median (~0.12%) and the nano-account range (1-3% for accounts under 10k followers), since the account starts at 0 followers.
